subject: Security intake: Greenfield Health — SOC2/HIPAA, vendor QA and pen test report request
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@greenfieldhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 10:15:00 -0500
Subject: Recap & next steps — Security intake for Greenfield Health evaluation

Hi Sarah — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so your team has a single place to reference: 

1) Compliance posture we discussed
- SOC 2: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II for our hosted platform (report available; final audit 2025-11). For Private/VPC deployments we maintain equivalent controls and can provide architecture-specific evidence; we can discuss scope for GFH.
- GDPR: We support EU data-region options and standard DPAs.
- HIPAA: We support HIPAA workflows and are willing to sign a BAA for PHI-handling customers.

2) Pen test and vulnerability process requests
- We can share a redacted copy of our latest pen test summary. Full reports are available under NDA — typically we route those through our security team.
- Typical cadence we recommend: authenticated internal scans monthly, unauthenticated external quarterly, and a full third-party penetration test annually (or tied to major releases).
- Remediation SLAs (suggested): Critical: 30 days; High: 90 days; Medium/low tracked by triage and backlog. For dedicated deployments we can negotiate different SLAs in the contract.

3) Vendor security questionnaire
- Attaching the Redwood vendor questionnaire (filled-in template) for your security team to review; if you prefer, we can ingest GFH’s questionnaire and return a completed version within 3 business days.
Attachment: Redwood_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_2026.pdf

4) Next steps / asks for GFH
- Please share your pen test report or an internal summary (redacted as needed). If a full report requires an NDA, flag that and we’ll circulate our mutual NDA template.
- Confirm procurement contact and timeline (I noted procurement@greenfieldhealth.com) and anyone else to include for legal/compliance.
- Tell us whether GFH prefers Private deployment (VPC/on-prem) or Hosted — this affects certificate/access controls and SOC 2 scope.

5) Proposed follow-ups
- Security deep-dive with Rishi and GFH security: propose Tue 3/2 or Wed 3/3 (30–45 min). 
- If GFH wants a MAP/Milestone list we’ll draft one (owner, dates, dependencies).

Thanks — I’ll loop in Monica for procurement/contracting next.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Exec | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai | +1 617-555-0183

--
From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@greenfieldhealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Eric Brown <eric.brown@greenfieldhealth.com>, procurement@greenfieldhealth.com
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 11:02:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps — Security intake for Greenfield Health evaluation

Thanks Sean — appreciate the summary. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

- HIPAA/BAA: HIPAA eligibility is a hard requirement for any vendor storing PHI. Can you confirm Redwood’s standard BAA terms and a contact for legal to speed this up?
- Pen test report: we can accept a redacted PDF to start. If you require an NDA, we can sign Redwood’s template or execute ours (procurement looped in).
- Deployment: GFH’s primary requirement is Private (VPC) with dedicated networking; SOC 2 scope will need to include that environment.

I attached our internal security requirements doc so you can see the baseline items we evaluate. We’d like to get the pen test summary and your vuln disclosure policy by EOD Monday if possible.
Attachment: GFH_security_requirements_v1.pdf

Also copying Eric (security lead) for technical follow-up.

—Sarah
Sarah Jenkins
Head of Platform Security | Greenfield Health
sarah.jenkins@greenfieldhealth.com | +1 212-555-0129

--
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@greenfieldhealth.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Eric Brown <eric.brown@greenfieldhealth.com>, scans@securescan.io
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 12:10:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps — Security intake for Greenfield Health evaluation

Hi Sarah — thanks for the note. I’m Rishi (head of security ops at Redwood). A few concrete answers and attachments to help your review: 

SOC 2 and HIPAA
- SOC 2: Our latest Type II was completed 2025-11 and covers core platform controls for hosted environments. For Private/VPC we maintain the same control set; we’ll scope and provide a tailored SOC evidence package for GFH as part of the onboarding.
- HIPAA: We do sign BAAs. I’m attaching our standard BAA addendum language and high-level controls mapping. We can have legal exchange templates; Sean, can you introduce legal if GFH prefers to push your NDA/BAA first?

Pen test / Scan details
- Attached: redwood_pen_test_summary_2025-12.pdf (redacted executive summary of our most recent third-party test). Full report is available under NDA.
- Vuln management: we run authenticated internal scans weekly for high-risk code paths, monthly scheduled authenticated scans for the platform, and external unauthenticated scans quarterly. We engage a third-party pentest vendor annually or on major releases.
- Disclosure policy: we follow coordinated disclosure with request windows — Critical: 30 days to remediation or compensating controls, High: 90 days; we issue CVEs for confirmed findings and publish a rolling advisory if applicable. See attached policy.
Attachment: redwood_pen_test_summary_2025-12.pdf
Attachment: redwood_vuln_disclosure_policy.pdf

Third-party vendor
- Our current preferred independent vendor is SecureScan Labs (cc’d). If GFH prefers a different assessor, we’ll accommodate. SecureScan performed our 2025 engagement and can share scope and methodology under NDA.

Next steps
- If GFH can share an NDA direction, we’ll return the full report within 2 business days of signature.
- I’ll prepare a one-page mutual action plan (MAP) that includes: deliverables (reports, questionnaires), owners (Rishi/Redwood security, Sarah/Greenfield security), and dates (NDA sig, report delivery, security deep-dive, procurement sign-off).

Links:
- Security bundle (questionnaire, pen test summary, policy): https://drive.redwood.ai/s/teams/security/greenfield-gfh

Happy to jump on the call next week — suggest Tue 3/2 11:00am ET.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security Ops | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0246

--
From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@greenfieldhealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, procurement@greenfieldhealth.com, Eric Brown <eric.brown@greenfieldhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 13:42:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps — Security intake for Greenfield Health evaluation

Thanks Rishi — that is exactly the level of detail we needed. A couple wrap-up items from GFH: 

- Please send the preferred NDA/BAA templates to procurement@greenfieldhealth.com this afternoon. If Redwood prefers GFH’s NDA instead, we’ll flag changes quickly.
- Can you include a point-of-contact at SecureScan Labs so we can discuss scope and shared expectations?
- For the MAP please include an estimated lead time to provision a Private/VPC environment for GFH (we typically budget 4–6 weeks depending on network approvals).

If you can get the full report under NDA and the MAP in the next 48 hours that would keep us on track for procurement review by mid-March. I’ll review the Drive bundle and follow up with specific questions.

—Sarah

Attachment: (none)
